goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann zentrale Verbraucherrechte und Rechtsdurchsetzung erläutern.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: The consumer calmly reports a defective kettle to the seller. Separate repair and intact replacement illustrations under Nacherfüllung provide the two conceptual cure routes; advice is a separate help route. No unconditional cash refund, no voluntary-warranty conflation and no free-return promise is shown.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px defective kettle, seller discussion and two distinct repair/replacement alternatives remain clear with short large labels.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px cracked kettle with spanner differs clearly from intact replacement; separate advice path is visible.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Seller monitor and adviser laptop show their backs to the audience, with screens facing the actual users. The floating receipt is an illustration, not a misoriented document held for reading.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The scene illustrates possible defect cure, not exhaustive legal conditions or an automatic entitlement for every return. The repair/replacement distinction was cross-checked against the official BGB §439(1) search excerpt at https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/BJNR001950896.html?11517a81_page=0 on 2026-10-08; the direct §439 fetch timed out, so no successful direct-page fetch is claimed.
